        } else {

    }

    private fun getExpectedType(node: UCallExpression): PsiType? {
        var current: UExpression = node

        while (true) {

                is UParenthesizedExpression -> {
                    current = parent

                is UQualifiedReferenceExpression -> {

                    if (index >= 0) {

                        }
                    }
                    return null
                }
                else -> return null
            }
            parent = current.uastParent ?: return null
        }
    }
